test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No correction required’.**

__Everyone sincerely and positively were__ ready to find the solution for the serious issue of sewage system.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Everyone was sincerely and positively.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**Everyone**," which is a singular pronoun.
 
• In English
